topic.title: Structured Optimization, Relaxation, and Solver Acceleration
topic.overview: Many learning tasks depend on solving constrained optimization problems efficiently. This cluster studies convex relaxations, interior-point methods, discrete inference, learned warm starts, and parameter-free tuning. The common theme is exploiting problem structure without losing the feasibility or solution-quality properties that make a solver trustworthy.
topic.whyItMatters: A learned prediction or approximate linear solve can accelerate an optimizer, but errors must be incorporated into the guarantee. Practical speedups are most useful when they do not silently change the original constrained problem.
topic.evolution: Early examples explore annealing, analog optimization, and compiled knowledge. Later work improves MAP relaxations and randomized linear algebra inside interior-point methods. Recent representatives predict multipliers or nearby optimal sets and study fully parameter-free stochastic search, broadening how data and adaptivity can reduce manual solver design.
openQuestions: Which learned warm starts remain beneficial when instance structure shifts?
Can approximation errors be monitored cheaply enough to preserve end-to-end feasibility guarantees?

papers.title: Autonomous Sparse Mean-CVaR Portfolio Optimization
papers.tldr: The proposed portfolio model approximates an asset-count-constrained mean-CVaR problem while supporting efficient optimization and continuity in asset selection.

papers.title: Box Facets and Cut Facets of Lifted Multicut Polytopes
papers.tldr: Lower box facets receive an efficiently checkable exact characterization, while recognizing cut facets is shown to be NP-hard.

papers.title: Compact Optimality Verification for Optimization Proxies
papers.tldr: A compact verification formulation and gradient-based heuristic make it more practical to assess optimization proxies’ worst-case optimality gaps.

papers.title: Fast, Scalable, Warm-Start Semidefinite Programming with Spectral Bundling and Sketching
papers.tldr: USBS combines spectral bundling, optional matrix sketching, and warm starts to solve massive semidefinite programs efficiently.

papers.title: From Inverse Optimization to Feasibility to ERM
papers.tldr: Reformulating contextual inverse linear programming as feasibility and smooth risk minimization enables scalable algorithms, convex-setting guarantees, and generalization analysis.

papers.title: Learning to Remove Cuts in Integer Linear Programming
papers.tldr: Learned policies for removing earlier cuts improve cutting-plane performance in studied combinatorial optimization settings.

papers.title: Multiplicative Weights Update, Area Convexity and Random Coordinate Descent for Densest Subgraph Problems
papers.tldr: New iterative dense-subgraph algorithms improve convergence guarantees while remaining practical on large graphs.

papers.title: Overcoming the Optimizer’s Curse: Obtaining Realistic Prescriptions from Neural Networks
papers.tldr: The method constrains neural-network optimization using a tractable outlier measure to obtain more realistic decisions efficiently.

papers.title: Parsimonious Learning-Augmented Approximations for Dense Instances of $\mathcalNP$-hard Problems
papers.tldr: A logarithmic number of one-bit predictions speeds approximation schemes for dense hard problems while preserving guarantees that account for prediction error.

papers.title: Position: Optimization in SciML Should Employ the Function Space Geometry
papers.tldr: The paper advocates designing SciML optimization in function space before discretization and formalizes that approach as an algorithm-design framework.

papers.title: Predicting Lagrangian Multipliers for Mixed Integer Linear Programs
papers.tldr: A graph-based encoder–decoder predicts Lagrangian multipliers that produce strong MILP bounds and useful warm starts for iterative optimization.

papers.title: Robust Data-driven Prescriptiveness Optimization
papers.tldr: A distributionally robust model optimizes contextual prescriptiveness directly and admits a linear-program-based solver under structural conditions.

papers.title: Tackling Prevalent Conditions in Unsupervised Combinatorial Optimization: Cardinality, Minimum, Covering, and More
papers.tldr: The paper derives probabilistic objectives and derandomization procedures for common combinatorial constraints, reporting gains in solution quality and speed.

papers.title: Accelerating ERM for data-driven algorithm design using output-sensitive techniques
papers.tldr: An output-sensitive approach accelerates algorithm parameter learning by making search cost depend on the loss regions that actually occur.

papers.title: Boundary Decomposition for Nadir Objective Vector Estimation
papers.tldr: BDNE estimates nadir objective vectors through boundary subproblems and bilevel optimization, with identification guarantees under mild conditions.

papers.title: FERERO: A Flexible Framework for Preference-Guided Multi-Objective Learning
papers.tldr: FERERO expresses relative and absolute preferences within constrained multi-objective optimization and provides convergent algorithms for finding preferred trade-offs.

papers.title: Generalization Bound and Learning Methods for Data-Driven Projections in Linear Programming
papers.tldr: Learning projection matrices from past linear programs improves compressed solution quality, with generalization bounds supporting the approach.

papers.title: Gliding over the Pareto Front with Uniform Designs
papers.tldr: A max-packing surrogate selects representative Pareto-optimal solutions with fill distance guaranteed to be within four times the optimum.

papers.title: MILP-StuDio: MILP Instance Generation via Block Structure Decomposition
papers.tldr: MILP-StuDio generates useful optimization instances by editing structural blocks, improving learning-based solver times by more than 10% in reported benchmarks.

papers.title: Multidimensional Fractional Programming for Normalized Cuts
papers.tldr: A multidimensional fractional-programming transformation turns normalized-cut clustering into an iterative bipartite matching problem with convergence support.

papers.title: Optimization Algorithm Design via Electric Circuits
papers.tldr: The paper designs convex optimization algorithms by constructing convergent circuit dynamics and automatically converting them into provably convergent discrete updates.

papers.title: OT4P: Unlocking Effective Orthogonal Group Path for Permutation Relaxation
papers.tldr: OT4P makes permutation optimization differentiable through a temperature-controlled mapping to orthogonal matrices.

papers.title: S-SOS: Stochastic Sum-Of-Squares for Parametric Polynomial Optimization
papers.tldr: S-SOS uses a convergent semidefinite hierarchy to bound polynomial optima and extract candidate solutions under random external parameters.

papers.title: Breaking the Quadratic Barrier: Robust Cardinality Sketches for Adaptive Queries
papers.tldr: New cardinality estimators support exponentially many adaptive queries when each element participates in only a bounded, roughly quadratic number of queries.

papers.title: Differentiable Quadratic Optimization For the Maximum Independent Set Problem
papers.tldr: pCQO-MIS combines a clique-informed quadratic objective with parallel gradient optimization to find large independent sets without training data.

papers.title: Fast Min-$ε$ Segmented Regression using Constant-Time Segment Merging
papers.tldr: Precomputed sample matrices make segment merging and error calculation constant-time, enabling faster segmented regression with substantially lower reported errors.

papers.title: Faster Global Minimum Cut with Predictions
papers.tldr: Predictions guide randomized minimum-cut algorithms toward near-linear running time when accurate, with robustness to prediction errors.

papers.title: Improved Approximations for Hard Graph Problems using Predictions
papers.tldr: Weak edge-based predictions enable improved approximation algorithms by guiding high-degree constraints while conventional methods handle low-degree vertices.

papers.title: Learning Initial Basis Selection for Linear Programming via Duality-Inspired Tripartite Graph Representation and Comprehensive Supervision
papers.tldr: A duality-inspired graph network learns feasible, useful simplex starting bases, improving prediction accuracy and reducing solver iterations and runtime.

papers.title: Learning to Generate Projections for Reducing Dimensionality of Heterogeneous Linear Programming Problems
papers.tldr: A neural network learns instance-specific projections that reduce linear-program size and enable faster, high-quality feasible solutions across heterogeneous problems.

papers.title: Optimization over Sparse Support-Preserving Sets: Two-Step Projection with Global Optimality Guarantees
papers.tldr: A two-step projection method handles sparse support-preserving constraints with conditional global objective guarantees and an explicit sparsity–suboptimality tradeoff.

papers.title: Pareto-Optimal Fronts for Benchmarking Symbolic Regression Algorithms
papers.tldr: Exhaustive searches produce absolute accuracy–length tradeoff fronts for 34 SRBench datasets, providing reference limits for symbolic regression evaluation.

papers.title: Scalable First-order Method for Certifying Optimal k-Sparse GLMs
papers.tldr: An efficient proximal-gradient solver accelerates the dual bounds needed to certify optimal sparse generalized linear models.

papers.title: Secant Line Search for Frank-Wolfe Algorithms
papers.tldr: A secant-based step-size strategy offers full-line-search effectiveness at lower computational cost for Frank-Wolfe algorithms under mild assumptions.

papers.title: A Computationally Viable Numerical Gradient-based Technique for Optimal Covering Problems
papers.tldr: The paper combines a continuity result, stochastic smoothing, and randomized restarts to numerically search for optimal geometric covers.

papers.title: Accelerated Evolving Set Processes for Local PageRank Computation
papers.tldr: A framework combining nested evolving sets with approximate local solves accelerates Personalized PageRank, with graph-size-independent complexity in a stated regime.

papers.title: Bridging Arbitrary and Tree Metrics via Differentiable Gromov Hyperbolicity
papers.tldr: DeltaZero uses a differentiable measure of tree-likeness to optimize tree metrics with strong guarantees and low empirical distortion.

papers.title: Differentiable extensions with rounding guarantees for combinatorial optimization over permutations
papers.tldr: Birkhoff Extension makes permutation objectives differentiable almost everywhere while guaranteeing that rounding does not worsen their value.

papers.title: Fast Projection-Free Approach (without Optimization Oracle) for Optimization over Compact Convex Set
papers.tldr: Hom-PGD transforms constrained optimization into a ball-constrained problem, achieving stated gradient-descent convergence rates without expensive projection or optimization oracles.

papers.title: FRAM: Frobenius-Regularized Assignment Matching with Mixed-Precision Computing
papers.tldr: FRAM improves graph-matching relaxation and reports up to 370-fold GPU speedup over its FP64 CPU implementation without accuracy loss.

papers.title: Generalization Bounds for Model-based Algorithm Configuration
papers.tldr: The paper derives a stability-based generalization bound for a model closely approximating practical model-based algorithm configurators.

papers.title: Inexact Column Generation for Bayesian Network Structure Learning via Difference-of-Submodular Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper accelerates a bottleneck in Bayesian network structure learning through an inexact difference-of-submodular optimization method.

papers.title: The Complexity of Finding Local Optima in Contrastive Learning
papers.tldr: Finding local optima in several contrastive-learning problems is computationally hard, with some local-search instances requiring exponential time.

papers.title: Why Popular MOEAs Are Popular: Proven Advantages in Approximating the Pareto Front
papers.tldr: The paper proves polynomial expected runtime for popular evolutionary algorithms approximating LargeFront, contrasting with GSEMO’s exponential runtime on the same task.

papers.title: Batched First-Order Methods for Parallel LP Solving in MIP
papers.tldr: Batching related linear programs lets a first-order solver exploit GPUs and outperform simplex methods in identified computational settings.

papers.title: Finding Most Influential Sets
papers.tldr: For linear-fractional removal effects, the paper replaces exhaustive influential-set search with efficiently solvable top-k problems and provides conditional recovery guarantees.

papers.title: Learning the Best Under Constraints: A Duality-Based Framework
papers.tldr: The paper derives sample-complexity limits for constrained best-arm identification and uses convex duality to build an efficient relaxed algorithm.

papers.title: Local Minima in Quadratic-Penalty Relaxations of Binary Linear Programs
papers.tldr: The paper gives sufficient penalty conditions ensuring that every local minimum of certain relaxed binary optimization problems is binary and feasible.

papers.title: Local-Minima-Preserving Polynomial Relaxation of Ising Problems
papers.tldr: A polynomial relaxation exactly matches its local minima to one-flip Ising minima, enabling gradient-based search with a precise discrete interpretation.

papers.title: On Densest $k$-Subgraph Mining and Diagonal Loading: Optimization Landscape and Finite-Step Exact Convergence Analysis
papers.tldr: The paper proves a tight densest-subgraph relaxation and finite-step convergence of a saddle-escaping algorithm to an integral local maximum.

papers.title: Provably Data-driven Lagrangian Relaxation for Mixed Integer Linear Programming
papers.tldr: The paper proves optimal learning rates for Lagrangian multipliers and a faster rate for learning optimization warm starts.

papers.title: SoftJAX & SoftTorch: Empowering Automatic Differentiation Libraries with Informative Gradients
papers.tldr: SoftJAX and SoftTorch provide integrated soft replacements for hard operations that otherwise obstruct gradient-based optimization.

papers.title: The Theory and Practice of MAP Inference over Non-Convex Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper identifies an exactly solvable class of constrained MAP problems and develops a structure-aware optimization strategy for broader nonconvex cases.

papers.title: Towards Fully Parameter-Free Stochastic Optimization: Grid Search with Self-Bounding Analysis
papers.tldr: GRASP uses grid search and self-bounding analysis to pursue strong optimization guarantees without unverifiable prior bounds on problem parameters.
